mission: Solidify Test Base: Eliminate Hanging Tests and Reduce Test Time

tasks.title: Analyze hanging test patterns in autonomous_audit_loop
tasks.description: Analyze test_autonomous_audit_loop.py to identify root causes of 5.4-minute timeout. Focus on: (1) asyncio.sleep() delays, (2) subprocess.run() blocking commands, (3) recursive test execution risks, (4) missing per-function timeouts. Generate detailed spec with acceptance criteria for each fix.
acceptance_criteria: Root causes documented with line numbers and code snippets
Impact analysis: quantify time added by each issue (e.g., 3 asyncio.sleep(1) = 3 seconds)
Risk assessment: identify blocking vs non-blocking issues
Prioritization matrix: P0 (blocking hangs) vs P1 (performance) vs P2 (code quality)
Spec includes before/after metrics (current: 4+ sec, target: <500ms for unit tests)

tasks.title: Write test to verify no intentional delays in test execution
tasks.description: Create test to ensure autonomous_audit_loop() completes in <500ms for unit tests. Use monkeypatch to mock asyncio.sleep(). Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (3 cycles, mocked sleep), Edge (0 cycles, 1000 cycles), Error (sleep throws exception), Security (ensure sleep can't be exploited), Scale (1000 cycles in <2s with mocked sleep).
acceptance_criteria: Test passes with current code (has asyncio.sleep)
Test fails when asyncio.sleep removed (validates test works)
Test uses monkeypatch to mock asyncio.sleep
Test measures execution time (<500ms for unit tests)
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Security, Scale)

tasks.title: Remove asyncio.sleep() from test autonomous loop
tasks.description: Remove all asyncio.sleep() calls from autonomous_audit_loop() function in tests/integration/test_autonomous_audit_loop.py. Delete lines with 'await asyncio.sleep(1)' or similar. Verify no intentional delays remain. Preserve all actual test logic (cleanup, audit, prioritization, validation).
acceptance_criteria: All asyncio.sleep() calls removed from test functions
Test still validates all 6 steps (pre-flight, audit, prioritization, refactoring, validation, post-flight)
Test passes in <500ms (down from 4+ seconds)
No broken tests introduced
Git diff shows only asyncio.sleep() deletions, no logic changes

tasks.title: Write test to verify process cleanup is non-blocking
tasks.description: Create test to ensure pre_flight_cleanup() and post_flight_cleanup() complete in <200ms. Test should verify: (1) cleanup doesn't block on xargs with no processes, (2) cleanup has timeout, (3) cleanup uses psutil or pgrep instead of pipe chains. Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (cleanup with no processes), Edge (cleanup with 10 processes), Error (pgrep fails), Security (can't kill non-test processes), Async (concurrent cleanup calls).
acceptance_criteria: Test fails with current subprocess.run() implementation (validates issue exists)
Test passes with psutil or pgrep implementation
Test measures cleanup time (<200ms)
Test verifies no blocking on xargs
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Security, Async)

tasks.title: Replace blocking subprocess cleanup with non-blocking psutil
tasks.description: Replace subprocess.run() with pipe chains in pre_flight_cleanup() and post_flight_cleanup(). Use Python's psutil library instead: iterate psutil.process_iter(), filter by 'pytest' in name, kill if PID != current_pid. Add timeout=2 to prevent hangs. Ensure no xargs blocking issues.
acceptance_criteria: psutil replaces all subprocess.run() with pipe chains in cleanup functions
Cleanup completes in <200ms (measured)
Cleanup has timeout (2 seconds max)
No xargs or grep blocking issues remain
Current PID excluded from kill (no self-termination)
Tests pass at 100%

tasks.title: Write test to verify all async tests have timeouts
tasks.description: Create meta-test to scan test_autonomous_audit_loop.py and ensure all @pytest.mark.asyncio functions have @pytest.mark.timeout() decorators. Test should parse AST, find async test functions, verify timeout decorator exists. Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (all tests have timeouts), Edge (timeout value appropriate for function complexity), Error (missing timeout decorator), Security (timeout can't be bypassed).
acceptance_criteria: Test scans Python AST for async test functions
Test verifies @pytest.mark.timeout() decorator present
Test validates timeout values (unit: 5s, integration: 10s)
Test fails if any async test missing timeout
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Security)

tasks.title: Add @pytest.mark.timeout() to all async test functions
tasks.description: Add @pytest.mark.timeout() decorator to all async test functions in tests/integration/test_autonomous_audit_loop.py. Use timeout=5 for unit tests (cleanup, prioritization, validation) and timeout=10 for integration test (full cycle). Ensure pytest-timeout is in requirements.txt.
acceptance_criteria: All async test functions have @pytest.mark.timeout() decorator
Timeout values appropriate: 5s for unit, 10s for integration
pytest-timeout added to requirements.txt or pyproject.toml
Tests still pass at 100%
Hanging tests now fail fast (within timeout) instead of hanging forever

tasks.title: Write test to verify unit/integration test separation
tasks.description: Create test to ensure unit tests (fast, no delays) are marked separately from integration tests (slow, full cycles). Test should verify: (1) pytest markers exist (@pytest.mark.unit, @pytest.mark.integration), (2) unit tests complete in <100ms each, (3) integration tests allowed up to 10s. Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (run unit tests only), Edge (run integration tests only), Error (missing markers), Security (markers can't be bypassed).
acceptance_criteria: Test validates pytest marker separation
Test measures unit test execution time (<100ms)
Test verifies integration test markers present
Test ensures -m 'not integration' runs only fast tests
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Security)

tasks.title: Separate unit and integration tests with pytest markers
tasks.description: Add pytest markers to tests/integration/test_autonomous_audit_loop.py: @pytest.mark.unit for fast tests (cleanup, prioritization, validation), @pytest.mark.integration for full cycle test. Update pytest.ini to register markers. Document in test file docstring: 'Run unit tests: pytest -m "not integration" -v' and 'Run all tests: pytest -v'.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests marked with @pytest.mark.unit
Integration tests marked with @pytest.mark.integration
pytest.ini registers custom markers
Documentation added to test file docstring
pytest -m 'not integration' runs only unit tests (<500ms total)
pytest -v runs all tests (unit + integration)

tasks.title: Write test to verify asyncio.sleep is mocked in unit tests
tasks.description: Create test to ensure unit tests use monkeypatch to mock asyncio.sleep, while integration tests use real sleep (if needed). Test should verify: (1) unit tests complete instantly with mocked sleep, (2) integration tests allowed real sleep, (3) mocked sleep called correct number of times. Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (mock works), Edge (sleep(0) vs sleep(1000)), Error (mock throws exception), Security (mock can't be bypassed).
acceptance_criteria: Test verifies unit tests mock asyncio.sleep
Test measures unit test time (should be instant with mock)
Test validates integration tests can use real sleep if needed
Test counts asyncio.sleep calls (should be 0 for unit tests)
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Security)

tasks.title: Add monkeypatch to mock asyncio.sleep in unit tests
tasks.description: Update unit tests to use monkeypatch.setattr('asyncio.sleep', lambda x: None) at start of each unit test function. This makes unit tests instant by skipping sleep delays. Keep real asyncio.sleep in integration test (if needed for realistic timing). Document monkeypatch usage in test docstrings.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests use monkeypatch to mock asyncio.sleep
Unit tests complete instantly (<100ms each)
Integration test uses real asyncio.sleep if needed
No asyncio.sleep delays in unit test execution
Tests pass at 100%
Monkeypatch documented in test docstrings

tasks.title: Write performance regression test for test suite
tasks.description: Create test to ensure test suite performance doesn't regress. Test should: (1) measure total test execution time, (2) verify unit tests complete in <500ms, (3) verify integration tests complete in <10s, (4) fail if performance regresses >20%. Follow NECESSARY pattern: Normal (all tests within budget), Edge (single slow test detected), Error (timeout occurs), Scale (1000 test functions).
acceptance_criteria: Test measures test suite execution time
Test enforces performance budget (unit: <500ms, integration: <10s)
Test fails if performance regresses >20%
Test identifies specific slow tests (outliers)
Test covers NECESSARY pattern (Normal, Edge, Error, Scale)

tasks.title: Verify all hanging test fixes and measure performance
tasks.description: Run full test suite with pytest -v and measure performance. Verify: (1) no asyncio.sleep in unit tests, (2) psutil replaces subprocess pipes, (3) all async tests have timeouts, (4) unit/integration separation works, (5) unit tests <500ms, integration <10s. Document performance improvements in migration doc.
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite passes at 100%
Unit tests complete in <500ms (down from 4+ seconds)
Integration tests complete in <10s
No hanging tests (all have timeouts)
Performance improvement documented (before/after metrics)
pytest -m 'not integration' runs only fast tests

tasks.title: Update test documentation with performance guidelines
tasks.description: Update tests/integration/test_autonomous_audit_loop.py docstring and create docs/testing/PERFORMANCE_GUIDELINES.md. Document: (1) unit vs integration test rules, (2) timeout requirements (@pytest.mark.timeout), (3) asyncio.sleep mocking (monkeypatch), (4) process cleanup best practices (psutil), (5) performance budgets (unit: <100ms, integration: <10s). Include examples of good/bad test patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Test file docstring updated with performance guidelines
docs/testing/PERFORMANCE_GUIDELINES.md created
Guidelines include unit vs integration test rules
Guidelines include timeout requirements
Guidelines include asyncio.sleep mocking examples
Guidelines include good/bad test pattern examples
Constitutional compliance referenced (Article I: complete context, Article II: 100% verification)

tasks.title: Create migration summary document for test solidification
tasks.description: Create docs/migrations/test_solidification_hanging_tests.md summarizing all fixes. Include: (1) problems identified (asyncio.sleep, subprocess blocking, missing timeouts), (2) solutions implemented (psutil, monkeypatch, pytest markers), (3) before/after metrics (4+ sec → <500ms), (4) constitutional alignment (Articles I-III), (5) future prevention (performance budgets, CI gates). Follow ADR-032 style documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Migration doc created: docs/migrations/test_solidification_hanging_tests.md
Document includes problems, solutions, metrics (before/after)
Document references constitutional articles (I, II, III)
Document includes future prevention strategies
Document follows ADR-032 style (context, decision, consequences)
Document includes code examples of fixes

checkpoints.prompt: Validate P0 fixes: (1) asyncio.sleep removed, (2) psutil cleanup non-blocking, (3) timeouts added. All tests must pass at 100%.
Validate test organization: (1) unit/integration separation works, (2) unit tests <500ms, (3) integration tests <10s. Performance regression test must pass.
